# Tanya's Sprint Retro

Tanya: "We shipped the async decision widget. Velocity was 23 points, highest this quarter. The Zephyr integration was the key unlock."

segments.exact: We shipped the async decision widget. Velocity was 23 points, highest this quarter. The Zephyr integration was the key unlock.

evidence.quote: Velocity was 23 points, highest this quarter

observations.why: Citing a quantified velocity score and ranking it as the quarter's highest appeals to achievement and demonstrated capability.

evidence.quote: We shipped the async decision widget.
Velocity was 23 points, highest this quarter.
The Zephyr integration was the key unlock.

observations.why: All three clauses report completed, actual events with named artifacts and a specific metric — past focus, realis modality, concrete construal throughout.

evidence.quote: Velocity was 23 points, highest this quarter.

observations.why: Citing a quantified team-performance metric to establish authority from demonstrated output — informational control of the facts that frame the retro's assessment.

evidence.quote: We shipped the async decision widget.
The Zephyr integration was the key unlock.

observations.why: Flat unhedged assertions of fact and causal attribution, stated with confidence but without ratification language or performed-settling — the claim/decision boundary falls on the claim side because nothing performs or records a settling act.
Domain jargon (async decision widget, velocity, points, key unlock) used natively without gloss, delivered in flat instrumental syntax — the document's baseline register signature.

mints.name: NativePipelineVocabulary
mints.title: domain jargon used natively without gloss, in flat instrumental delivery
mints.frame: Is the speaker deploying technical vocabulary as their own working language rather than performing expertise for an audience?

observations.why: 'unlock' frames the Zephyr integration as a mechanism that released a barrier — a thing spoken of AS another thing, not mere vividness.
Energized evaluative language — 'highest this quarter' and 'key unlock' — signals enthusiasm and positive valence at elevated arousal.

The 'we' framing enacts communal-sharing — the team as an undifferentiated collective that ships as one body — while the surrounding content (velocity points, integration unlock) is propositional and carries no further relational signal.

payload.focus: Tanya sprint retro, async decision widget shipped, velocity 23 points, Zephyr integration
payload.rationale: The document is a sprint retro covering the async decision widget ship, velocity metrics, and Zephyr integration. I expanded all focus-surfaced witnesses (Sprint 4 retro, Zephyr unlock position, velocity observation, thesis-proven position, metric-anchor style observation, Zephyr rate-limit observation) because they are the direct prior art this document extends. I also expanded the Anti-Slack positioning narrative and its children (anti-pattern, product category, target market, pricing) because the retro's thesis-proven claim and Zephyr-as-unlock directly bear on the positioning thesis and product category definition. I did not expand further into pricing or segmentation subtrees beyond what was already surfaced, as the document does not discuss pricing or ICP changes.
